newsitem.title: USA: CPI says will not make big Q3, Q4 gains.
newsitem.headline: CPI says will not make big Q3, Q4 gains.

text.p: CPI Corp said it does not expect to achieve its goal of very strong sales gains in the third and fourth quarter of its fiscal 1997.

"The current year has been a disappointing one. Because of high installation costs, training costs and research and development in the portrait studio operation, we needed a very strong sales increase in the third and fourth quarters to achieve improved profitability. That goal will not be achieved," said the photo studio and processing company.
CPI said it expects fiscal 1997 sales to exceed last year's as customer traffic has been good.

"But studio operating profits will be significantly less than last year. Prints Plus is also having a weak Christmas season so far, and will likely have lower sales and lower profits," the company said.

CPI said Tuesday that third quarter operating earnings declined 36.3 percent from the prior year's level, due mainly to flat Sears Portrait Studio sales, combined with higher cost of sales and other expenses in that segment.

"However, a gain from the sale of a share in the company's photofinishing segment resulted in a 54.3 percent increase in earnings from continuing operations, which without the gain would have declined 64.8 percent," CPI said.
CPI operates 1,200 retail locations, including 1,033 portrait studios inside Sears, Roebuck & Co stores.
